fFhddiBwYl.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that grounding trader heterogeneity in real transaction deviations from market consensus and evaluating across individual, population, and market levels is useful.
fFhddiBwYl.main_concern: Reviewers criticize the overly simplified two-feature residual representation (contrarian tendency and relative trade size), binary Polymarket-only scope, and reporting main comparisons on a 13-wallet validation set rather than the held-out test set.

SSc3MnQumR.one_liner: Pretrains dual-domain 3D MRI segmentation networks from undersampled k-space using spectral residuals as a soft prior plus lesion-presence gating.
SSc3MnQumR.problem: Label-efficient 3D brain tumor segmentation from undersampled MRI suffers when models ignore acquisition-domain k-space structure or rely on noisy reconstructions.
SSc3MnQumR.method: The framework jointly processes undersampled k-space and zero-filled images, uses pathology-associated k-space spectral residuals as a self-supervised soft prior during pretraining, and adds an auxiliary lesion-presence branch during fine-tuning to softly gate dense predictions and suppress false positives.
SSc3MnQumR.key_idea: Guide dual-domain undersampled MRI pretraining with k-space spectral residuals as a soft prior and modulate fine-tuned segmentation outputs with an auxiliary lesion-presence gate.
SSc3MnQumR.evidence: Evaluated on limited-label 3D brain tumor segmentation using BraTS with simulated 2D-FFT undersampled k-space and component ablations.
SSc3MnQumR.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that leveraging k-space spectral priors and presence-based false-positive gating for label-efficient undersampled MRI segmentation is well motivated and improves limited-label Dice.
SSc3MnQumR.main_concern: Reviewers point out that k-space is synthesized via 2D FFT from preprocessed BraTS images rather than raw MRI acquisitions, weakening acquisition-informed claims, and note that adding the spectral prior alone drops subject-level Dice (0.544 to 0.428) until presence gating is added.

BXUnpS9Y2b.one_liner: SinkQCB encodes backdoors in selected LLM attention heads and uses attention sinks to suppress them at full precision until quantization.
BXUnpS9Y2b.problem: Existing quantization-conditioned backdoors jointly optimize benign full-precision behavior and malicious quantized behavior in a tight weight subspace, limiting attack success.
BXUnpS9Y2b.method: SinkQCB separates behavior encoding from triggering via three-stage fine-tuning: it selects high-sink attention heads, implants malicious behaviors into those heads, and tunes attention sinks to suppress the heads at full precision while allowing post-training quantization to activate them.
BXUnpS9Y2b.key_idea: Isolates backdoor behaviors in selected attention heads whose contributions are gated off by attention sinks at full precision and re-exposed by quantization.
BXUnpS9Y2b.evidence: Evaluated across multiple LLMs, malicious tasks, and quantization methods, with head-level intervention analyses.
BXUnpS9Y2b.claimed_gains: Achieves higher post-quantization attack success rate while keeping full-precision ASR at or below 1%.
BXUnpS9Y2b.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that quantization-conditioned supply-chain backdoors are a realistic threat and that gating malicious heads with attention sinks is a concrete, insightful mechanism.
BXUnpS9Y2b.main_concern: Reviewers note limited novelty (combining Egashira et al. with Fu et al.'s attention-sink gating), comparison against only a single baseline with a confounded case, and missing ablations on head selection and loss hyperparameters.

GJp55CU2C2.one_liner: PhenoBIID forecasts unobserved weather-driven vegetation trajectories as a world model before predicting crop yield, evaluated on CropDynamicsBench.
GJp55CU2C2.problem: In-season crop yield predictors directly regress yield from partial observations, neglecting the unobserved weather-driven vegetation dynamics prior to harvest.
GJp55CU2C2.method: PhenoBIID formulates in-season yield estimation as a weather-conditioned vegetation world model with bidirectional vegetation-weather conditioning that rolls out hidden growth trajectories and predicts yield from the completed trajectory. The authors also introduce CropDynamicsBench covering maize, rice, soybean, and wheat globally.
GJp55CU2C2.key_idea: Forecasts unobserved weather-driven remote-sensing vegetation trajectories via bidirectional conditioning and predicts crop yield from the completed growth trajectory.
GJp55CU2C2.evidence: Retrospective evaluations across 4 crops and 13 years on CropDynamicsBench over three seeds against GRU, Random Forest, and LightGBM baselines.
GJp55CU2C2.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that in-season crop yield prediction is important and that the multi-crop, multi-year evaluation of intermediate vegetation trajectory modeling is well-structured.
GJp55CU2C2.main_concern: Reviewers note that historical-mean completion beats learned dynamics on rice and short windows, that using realized future weather is unrealistic in deployment, and that baselines omit modern architectures while the world-model framing adds unclear value over temporal forecasting.

3797olz2KN.one_liner: PICon probes LLM persona agents via chained multi-turn interrogation to measure internal, external, and retest consistency against humans.
3797olz2KN.problem: Existing persona-agent evaluations use independent questions and fail to jointly test internal, external, and retest consistency across a sustained interaction.
3797olz2KN.method: PICon is a black-box evaluation framework using logically chained multi-turn questioning to score persona agents along internal consistency (non-contradiction), external consistency (web-verifiable real-world compatibility), and retest consistency (stability under repeated questioning).
3797olz2KN.key_idea: Uses logically chained multi-turn interrogation to jointly score persona agents' internal, externally verified, and retest consistency against a human reference.
3797olz2KN.evidence: Evaluates nine persona-agent groups alongside 63 human participants under the same protocol, with questioner-prompt ablations and open-model checks.
3797olz2KN.reviewer_consensus: Reviewers agree that testing multi-turn biographical consistency with a human reference is a worthwhile diagnostic problem and appreciate the protocol ablations.
3797olz2KN.main_concern: Reviewers flag a discrepancy between the paper's external-consistency formula and the released code (handling of NEI claims), incomplete human validation of the four evaluator subtasks, and unclear links between consistency and faithful human simulation.
